name: Murasakino Nina
source:
A kind-hearted girl who was raised by Usagi after having been abandoned by her mother. She fell in love with Yukimachi Tsuzuku and enrolled in the high school he attends after spotting him when commuting to her previous school.

[Translation of [URL=http://stars.ponipa.com/star_pe.html#pe_c]official profile[/URL].]
